title: SFS Holdings Corp. Terminates 10b5-1 Plan
summary: UWMC (NYSE: UWMC) announced that Mat Ishbia, as controlling owner of SFS Holdings Corp., has terminated its Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. The trading plan was part of strategy implemented in 2025 in response to investor feedback requesting increased public float and trading liquidity. With the 10b5-1 plans having successfully increased liquidity of the stock such that average daily volume is now over 16 million shares and having increased float by over 135 million shares since June 2025, SFS terminated the plan effective Friday, May 8, the first day of UWMC’s open trading window since December 2025. SFS Holdings remains UWMC’s largest shareholder, with approximately 1.3 billion shares and believes it has done its part as the controlling shareholder to respond to the requests of the investment community by selling shares without regard to the stock price since June 2025.
